caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular, rug-like design with a wide outer border and an ornate central area. The border is decorated with dense floral patterns that include red, pink, white, and blue flowers with green leaves, all set against a light green background. The central area of the drawing features a cream or light beige field with a subtle, diamond-like mesh pattern, populated by scattered clusters of flowers in various shapes and sizes. Among the florals, there are also several birds rendered in bright colors such as red, yellow, blue, and brown, as well as a few butterfly-like insects. The arrangement inside the central field forms a ring of floral motifs with additional smaller sprays interspersed throughout, while the density of decoration is greatest towards the center and thins out toward the edges, allowing more of the background pattern to show through. The dominant colors in the composition are red, pink, green, blue, and cream, with touches of yellow, purple, and brown. The entire rug design is placed on a plain beige background.
title: Applique Quilt
cluster: #22 — Domestic Textiles: Coverlets, Tablecloths, and Rugs
